bullets: Power supply will be disrupted across over 100 locations in Chennai including parts of Ambattur and Pattabiram on September 22.
The district team should monitor affected areas in Thiruvallur and coordinate with utilities to minimize public disruption.

stories.title: Chennai Power Cut On Sep 22: Over 100 Locations To Be Hit By Supply
